rationale: The discourse has clarified the technical trade-offs, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and Lower Saxony insist on absolute no-closure/no-forced-layoff red lines, while management, owners, and investors still require economically equivalent structural savings. Positions have hardened over the last two rounds with repeated quantified requests but no substantive movement, so further unstructured rounds are unlikely to change the outcome without facilitation.
